title: Xanthe and the Letters
author: Petra Nystrom
blurb: Mara Ravensworth, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
